name: Avenging Angels
overview: Scripture reveals that angels are ministering spirits sent to serve those who will inherit salvation, highlighting their role in God's redemptive plan (Hebrews 1:14). Believers are encouraged to show hospitality, as some have unknowingly entertained angels, indicating their presence among us (Hebrews 13:2). However, not all angels remain faithful; those who abandoned their original position are reserved for judgment, underscoring the reality of angelic rebellion and divine justice (Jude 1:6). Additionally, even demons acknowledge the one true God and tremble, demonstrating the spiritual battle surrounding God's purposes (James 2:19).
